title: spec-kit-arch-governance domain manifest (.spec-arch-domain.yml)
description: The single shared record of a multi-repo governance domain — the namespace registry. A reader conforms to this format (in code, no runtime dependency). NOTE: cross-member uniqueness — each member's `name` and `namespace` MUST be unique across the set — is a WRITER invariant, not expressible in this structural schema; the writer enforces it. See INTEGRATION.md for the writer<->reader boundary.

members.description: The members of the domain. Each member's name and namespace must be unique (writer-enforced).

name.description: Human label for the repo in the set; unique across members.

role.description: The repo's role in the citation graph (must equal the shared vocabulary's roles).

namespace.description: The repo's role-based ADR prefix; unique across members (the registry).

locator.description: How to reach this member, relative to the authority repo (sibling path | git URL).
locator.$comment: e.g. "." for the authority itself, "../service" for a sibling, or a git URL
